# Tidymint

> Tidymint is a free, open-source (MIT) disk cleaner for macOS 14+, for Apple silicon and Intel Macs. Clean Now scans, shows what is safe to clean by group, and cleans only when the user presses Clean. It also cleans per app (Zalo, Chrome, Edge, Cốc Cốc, CapCut), uninstalls apps with their leftovers, finds large and duplicate files, maps disk usage, and lists startup items with their code signature. Every clean goes to the Trash and the last one can be undone. Interface in English and Vietnamese, six colour themes including a light one (Star White). Works offline, no tracking.

- Website (English): https://tidymint.app/
- Website (Vietnamese): https://tidymint.app/vi/
- Download (latest): https://github.com/HaiTrung-Workspace/tidymint/releases/latest/download/Tidymint.zip
- Source code: https://github.com/HaiTrung-Workspace/tidymint
- Privacy: https://github.com/HaiTrung-Workspace/tidymint/blob/main/PRIVACY.md
- Changelog: https://tidymint.app/changelog/ (Vietnamese: https://tidymint.app/vi/lich-su-cap-nhat/)
- Latest version number: https://tidymint.app/version.txt

## Key facts
- Price: free. No account, no subscription.
- Safety: never deletes permanently (Trash only, with Undo for the last clean); every cleanup group carries a safety level (safe / review / locked); never touches Photos, Mail, keychains, cloud storage roots or Apple system caches.
- Duplicates are found by content (SHA-256); before deleting, it checks whether scripts in the user's project folders still reference a file.
- Clean by App: caches pre-selected, photos and files listed by month for the user to pick, messages and logins locked; refuses to clean while the app is running.
- Startup Items: shows who signed each login item (Apple, a developer, unsigned) and flags unusual locations. Facts only, not antivirus.
- Not notarized by Apple yet: first launch needs System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway.
- Contact: hello@tidymint.app
